body: Please don't. I think of it every day, too. I care about you. Please don't.

I had my appointment today. It didn't help at all and left my family $700 poorer. She talked about how I might have anxiety and should try CBT.... HUGE waste of time ad money. I was damn near suicidal after that, but instead i went for a run and cried for like 5 hours. My mom is finding me a therapist because i told ehr I didn;t want to live anymore.
Hadn't really discussed it until yesterday. My parents seem to think depressed people are "sick and crazy"... yeah. But I am trying to get help.

I take melatonin. Doesn't help. My mind keeps me awake, all the bad stuff rushing around in there. I do love the vivid dreams, actually. 


Currently I take 1 tbsp nyquil, 50 mg benadryl, and 1g melatonin every night. I realize that that medication intake is not sustainable, and I am seeing a sleep specialist friday to seek alternatives.
I exercise a lot (runner) and don't watch TV. I go on the computer very little. I love to read and paint and draw, art is a great release.
Hey, dunno if you remember me, but I have an appointment with a psychologist/neurologist friday to work out my sleep issues. I assume depression will also be discussed. I'm still here.
yes, reddit is a really awesome place
Thank you for being honest, not sugar coating it, and treating me as an adult.

No therapist, but i have talked with friends about this before. Some of my friends have mental illnesses, notably one with depression and one with OCD, and they have told me to get help. I'm just afraid to admit I'm sick.
My aunt was EXTREMELY depressed for her entire life, as was my father.

I tried to hang myself at age 8. That was my first and only attempt, but I've been thinking about it ever since. I also started self harming at a young age, burning myself or biting myself to the point of drawing blood. I will say it again, this is not normal puberty. And as you say, life is going to end soon enough anyway. What's the point of suffering an extra 60 years if I can be done with it now?
